solves.reason: Pain/pleasure are 'formed and processed' in brain → processed. Homeostasis = 'balance' of bodily functions. 'Not be capable' with compensatory → capable.
Bodies 'strive' for homeostasis (not cease). 'Effective' mechanisms cushion extremes. Capable of 'surviving' (not perishing).
'Heavily reliant' on one another (not independent). 'Correspondingly' fall (logical cause-effect). 'Essential' component (not trivial).
Original text says 'heavily reliant' — lightly is the opposite and contextually inappropriate.
Mechanisms 'cushion' (buffer) extremes, not 'amplify' them. Amplifying would prevent survival.
Text says attempts to 'escape' misery make us more miserable. 'Embrace' contradicts the argument.
Defined as 'the balance of bodily functions' — this is the definition of homeostasis.
Mechanisms that 'cushion potential highs and lows' are compensatory by definition.
'___ our internal scale back to balance' — reset is the verb meaning to return to original state.
Strive = to make great effort. Endeavor = to try hard. Synonyms.
Maintain = to keep in existing state. Sustain = to keep going. Synonyms.
Attempts = tries/efforts. Efforts = attempts to achieve something. Synonyms.
Potential = possible/latent. Actual = real/existing. Antonyms.
Neutral = impartial/unbiased. Biased = prejudiced/partial. Antonyms.
(A) 'escape chronic back pain' = 벗어나다 (overcome/get free from). (B) 'planned a daring escape' = 탈출 (physical breakout, noun).
Definition describes a constituent part of a larger system → component. Element is close but lacks the machine/system specificity.
'is _____ as' requires past participle for passive voice: is defined as.
'_____ it will in turn reset' — gerund as subject: allowing it (the act of allowing it) will reset.
'Like _____; they work together and are reliant' → two sides of the same coin (idiomatic expression for inseparable duality).
'and _____ our internal scale back to balance' — completing the sentence about pain's role: allowing it will in turn reset.
